chunks.heading: Section 3. Prerequisite Master Configuration – Government Based Incentive › Section 1: Configuration of Government Based Incentive
chunks.text:
WFX provides a feature to configure government-based export incentives such as DBK (Duty Drawback) and RoSCTL (Rebate of State and Central Taxes and Levies) & RoDTEP (Remission of Duties and Taxes on Export Products) within the Incentive Master module.
It should be Group Company Wise.
Proposed Navigation for Incentive Configuration: Finance >> Master Definition >> AR Master >> Incentive Configuration
Incentive Master is divided into three sections:
• DBK Master
• RoSCTL Master
• RoDTEP Master
DBK Master, RoSCTL & RoDTEP:
Upon selecting the DBK, RoSCTL & RoDTEP from Incentive master, a configuration screen will open where DBK related Incentives can be set up.
UI Correction:
Segment field will be a text field.
RoDTEP Column names: RoDTEP No. , BEGIN DATE, EXPIRY DATE, CENTRAL RATE %, CENTRAL CAP, STATE RATE%, STATE CAP, Description.
DBK Column names: DBK No., BEGIN DATE, EXPIRY DATE, DBK RATE %, DBK CAP VALUE, SEGMENT, DESCRIPTION, UOM.
RoSCTL Column names : RoSCTL No., BEGIN DATE, EXPIRY DATE, CENTRAL RATE %, CENTRAL CAP, STATE RATE%, STATE CAP, Description
chunks.locator: § Section 3. Prerequisite Master Configuration – Government Based Incentive › Section 1: Configuration of Government Based Incentive

chunks.title: Section 1: Configuration of Government Based Incentive
chunks.heading: Section 3. Prerequisite Master Configuration – Government Based Incentive › Section 1: Configuration of Government Based Incentive

All the above fields are mandatory except description. Begin date will start from the beginning date of accounting books, maximum allowed percentages shall be 100% on the basis of sum of taxes. Sum of taxes percentage should not exceed 100%. The fields will remain editable until a transaction have been booked with current specs.
RoDTEP: Upon selecting the RodTEP from Incentive Master, a configuration screen will open where RodTEP related incentive values can be set up. User can maintain RodTEP No., Begin Date, Expiry Date, Central Rate %, Central Cap, State Rate % and State Cap. Begin Date and Expiry Date will be validated at the time of ASN or Shipping Bill, and based on the applicable date, RodTEP values will be calculated.
UOM – Will come from UOM master.
When the user gets an additional line of incentive with same no. As previous incentive no. Then the expiry date of Previous incentive no. Will freeze. And for new line the Begin date will be added and again expiry date for new line with same incentive no. Will be left blank.
Import: Will only be used for New Entry (Just like Insert command).

Significance of Log (Activity Timeline) Button:
A Log button is available on DBK, RoSCTL & RoDTEP Master screens. This button allows users to view the history of all changes made in the respective masters, including what was changed, who made the changes, and when they were made. It helps track updates and maintain transparency in the system.
Significance of Import/Export Button:
UI Correction: Inside Header level Context menu, we don't need Delete Button functionality.
An Import and Export button is provided in the DBK Master RoSCTL & RoDTEP Master screens. The Export button allows users to download the existing data in Excel format, make necessary changes offline, and use the Import button to upload the updated file back into the system. This feature is useful for bulk data updates and saves time compared to manual entry.
The same validations will be applicable in RoSCTL & RoDTEP.

chunks.text:
Shipment Plan Qty
• Type: Numeric Input
• Mandatory: Yes (should allow 0 value also)
• Validation:
• Shipping qty should not exceed order quantities + applicable tolerance.
• For any order / OC line, system should check already planned quantity + current entered planned quantity against available balance quantity including buyer tolerance. Eg- If order quantity is 100 pcs and buyer tolerance is 5%, then maximum allowed shipment planning is 105 pcs. Now suppose already shipment plans are created for 70 pcs. Then while creating/revising another shipment plan, user should not be allowed to enter more than 35 pcs.
Formula: Already Planned Qty + Current Input Shipment Qty ≤ Order Qty + Applicable Tolerance Qty or Current Input Shipment Qty ≤ Balance Qty including Tolerance

chunks.title: Status
chunks.heading: Section 4. Functional Requirement Description – Export Logistics Management › Grid and Pop up field incase of kitpack › Status
chunks.text:
The Status column in the Shipment Plan List will represent the current stage of the shipment plan based on system transactions and document creation. The statuses are defined as follows:
• Saved: Indicates that the shipment plan is in draft state and has been saved but not yet confirmed.
• Confirmed: Indicates that the shipment plan has been finalized and the transaction is confirmed.
• Closed: Indicates that the ASN (Advanced Shipment Notice) has been successfully created against the shipment plan.
• Booked: Indicates that the PSN Invoice has been generated for the shipment plan, confirming booking completion.
Shipment plan can only be revised before the confirmation of sales ASN. In case PSN (Confirmed) and ASN (Saved) are created and user revises the shipment plan then these documents will start appearing in d-sync status (with red color) and these document statuses will have tool sync with shipment plan. If these documents are not in sync, then system will not allow user to confirm the sales ASN. If PSN and ASN are created against shipment plan then qty information will be coming from shipment plan with non-editable mode. These tools will show on ASN new, ASN list, PSN new and PSN list screen. Screenshots are attached below.

chunks.title: Shipment Sequence Configurator:
chunks.heading: Section 4. Functional Requirement Description – Export Logistics Management › Shipment Sequence Configurator:
chunks.text:
UI Correction: FA → Master Definition → Account Receivables → Sequence Configurator
Path
FA → Master Definition → Account Receivables → Shipment Sequence Configurator
Purpose
The purpose of the Shipment Sequence Configurator is to define and control the sequence flow of shipment-related transactions within the system. This configuration helps users understand and manage how shipment transactions progress from Sales Order creation until Sales Invoice generation.
The configurator (Will work member company wise) ensures that transactions are created in the correct sequence as per business requirements and prevents users from skipping mandatory transaction stages.
Different flows can be configured under the Flow setup configurator.
Flow Type will be of two types only - Local & Export.
Under configure, user can define the flow of the transactions as per the flow rules mentioned below:
Row 1:
Value: Sales Order Only
Type: Static (non-editable)
Row 2:
Dropdown Options:
Shipment Plan
ASN
PSN
Buyer Order Dispatch
Row 3 (Depends on Row 2):
If row 2 selection is Shipment plan then ASN and PSN will appear in row 3 dropdown.
If row 2 selection is ASN then Buyer order dispatch and tax invoice will appear in row 3 dropdown.
If row 2 selection is PSN then ASN and Buyer order dispatch will appear in row 3 dropdown.
chunks.locator: § Section 4. Functional Requirement Description – Export Logistics Management › Shipment Sequence Configurator:

chunks.title: Shipment Sequence Configurator:
chunks.heading: Section 4. Functional Requirement Description – Export Logistics Management › Shipment Sequence Configurator:
chunks.text:
If row 2 selection is Buyer order dispatch then row 3 and row 4 will be unselectable and the flow will directly jump to row 5.
Row 4 (Depends on Row 3):
If row 2 selection is Shipment plan and row 3 selection is ASN then PSN and buyer order dispatch will appear in row 4 dropdown.
If row 2 selection is Shipment plan and row 3 selection is PSN then buyer order dispatch and tax invoice will appear in row 4 dropdown.
If row 2 selection is ASN, PSN or buyer order dispact and row 3 selection is any of the available options then row 4 will be disabled.
Row 5
Will show the option to select tax invoice or buyer order dispatch.
Row 6
Will show the option to select tax invoice or E-Invoice.
Row 7
Will show the option to select sales invoice.
Information (i) Button Functionality
The system shall provide an Information (i) button in the Shipment Sequence Configurator screen as shown in Image.
On Clicking the Information (i) Button:
• The system shall display the transaction flow for all configured cases.
• The flow visualization shall help users understand the sequence of transactions for each shipment flow case.
These cases will not be hard coded, there should be some flexibility to define these cases on the UI.
Note: if nothing is defined then user have to define the sequence.

chunks.title: Shahi Business Requirements
chunks.heading: Section 4. Functional Requirement Description – Export Logistics Management › Shahi Business Requirements
chunks.text: The sales/ Production team will create a shipment plan that can include multiple deliveries and multiple destinations, grouped under a primary destination which will auto-populate in the Pre-Shipment Export Invoice/ Sales ASN but can be modified by the logistics team during ASN creation, where only a single destination will be selected. Multiple ASNs can be created under a single shipment plan. The shipment plan remains editable by the factory until the ASN is in the creation stage; however, once the Pre-Booking is done and ASN is completed, the shipment plan becomes locked. If any changes are made to the shipment plan, the system will trigger an email alert to the respective authorized personnel, which will act as an approval mechanism for revising either the shipment plan, PSN or the ASN. Upon such changes, the PSN/ ASN quantity will be updated based on the shipment plan (for example, reducing order quantity from 100 to 80). In the Sales ASN confirmed mode, a checkbox labeled “Applied for Booking” will be introduced; once selected, neither the shipment plan, PSN or ASN can be revised. This checkbox can only be unchecked by an authorized user based on existing permission controls, after which revisions to both ASN and shipment plan will be allowed. Additionally, once the shipment is confirmed and an e-way bill is generated, the ASN can be recreated only by cancelling the tax invoice and generating a new ASN with the existing data but a new ASN number, specifically in cases where shipment execution fails or requires correction. The shipment plan will also include a shipment tolerance percentage driven from the Buyer Master, which can vary across different Shahi divisions.
